newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-THERN UNSURE ABOUT FUTURE AT ROMA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-THERN UNSURE ABOUT FUTURE AT ROMA.

text.p: Swedish international midfielder Jonas Thern is waiting to see how his Italian club Roma shape up this season before deciding whether to stay.

The player, who could make his return to the team on Saturday after being sidelined by a foot injury, told the daily Corriere dello Sport that Roma had offered him a new contract but he would not decide until after Christmas.
"The club president asked to talk to me about my future and we will get together in about two weeks," said Thern.
"I will make any decision after Christmas.

"At the moment I am thinking about going home but my decision will be influenced by how Roma do in the championship. I would like to play for a club that is finally among the leaders, it would be nice to win something in Italy."
Thern arrived in Italy in 1992 when he joined Napoli from Benfica of Portugal. Before that he was at Malmo.

Roma's aspirations and true value could become a lot clearer after their home match against league leaders Juventus on Saturday and their UEFA Cup second round second leg tie against Germany's Karlsruhe at the Olympic Stadium on Tuesday.
Karlsruhe won the first leg 3-0 and the second looks likely to be Roma's farewell to Europe this season.
